confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sydney prices; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain given neighbourhood and seasonal variation (July is winter). Cocktail and wine anchors use the beer anchor as a basis (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.3x) because direct recall of current bar prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Australian east-coast capital-city price levels, with Melbourne as the closest peer for dining and cafe prices; Sydney's premium for central hotels is reflected in the accommodation anchors.
